payout_quote: $200 Checking Bonus is available to new First Federal Bank customers who open a new personal Enhanced Checking Account through a representative at a branch or through a representative-assisted channel during the promotional period ending September 30, 2026.
steps: Visit a First Federal Bank of Kansas City branch (or representative-assisted channel) and open a new personal Enhanced Checking Account before September 30, 2026 - self-service online openings are not eligible

Receive qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 in a single calendar month within 60 days of account opening (ACH deposits of payroll, pension, Social Security, or government benefits only)
Keep the account open, active, and in good standing for at least 90 days from account opening
$200 bonus is credited within 30 days after all eligibility requirements are met
catches: In-branch or representative-assisted opening only - accounts opened through the bank's self-service online process are explicitly excluded

Requires $1,000+ in real payroll/pension/government direct deposits in a single calendar month within 60 days - P2P, mobile payment transfers, remote/ATM deposits, and bank-to-bank transfers do not qualify
Enhanced Checking requires a $50 minimum opening deposit and carries a $9 monthly service charge unless 20+ debit card purchase transactions post in the statement cycle
Account must remain open, active, and in good standing for at least 90 days
Promotional period ends September 30, 2026 - only days remaining at check time
Limit one bonus per customer tax ID; bonus may be subject to tax reporting
First Federal Bank of Kansas City serves the Kansas City metro area and surrounding states
biggest_catch: You must physically open the account at a branch (or with a representative) - the convenient online signup is explicitly excluded - and then route $1,000+ of real payroll into the account within 60 days while it carries a $9/month fee unless you make 20+ debit transactions monthly.
eligibility: New First Federal Bank customers opening a personal Enhanced Checking Account in-branch or via representative-assisted channel before 9/30/2026; must be able to receive $1,000+/month qualifying direct deposits.
timing: $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits due in a single calendar month within 60 days of opening; account must stay open/active/in good standing for 90 days; bonus credited within 30 days after all requirements are met.
weasel_words: Offer may be subject to change at any time
